scientific_integrity: All novelty claims concern the stated sharp variance and rare-event coefficients. Unbiasedness, the algorithm and its normalization, and spherical Gaussian identities are credited to earlier literature. Same-model scrutiny only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite dimension and Gaussian samples; no growing-dimension or non-Gaussian result.
Exact arithmetic and one-spike flat-tail positive definite matrices.
The normalized estimator is already in the source paper; the new result is its sharp variance comparison.
The four-matvec budget is smaller than ambient dimension only for n>=5.
Older equivalent singular Gaussian-projection results cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Sharp near-rank-one variance and normalization gain for four-matvec XTrace
